activity.notes: Representative interval for John son of Zebedee's participation in the Jesus movement and the earliest Jerusalem/Samaria Christian mission traditions; not a lifespan. This Person is not automatically identified with the author of the Gospel of John, the author of the Johannine epistles, or John of Patmos.

sources.title: New Testament — Mark 1:19–20; Acts 3:1–4:22; Acts 8:14–25
sources.citation_text: Early Christian sources identify John son of Zebedee as one of Jesus' disciples and place John alongside Peter in early Jerusalem and Samaritan mission traditions.

namuwiki.reason: Direct canonical NamuWiki target verification was not available; no URL is invented and no absence is asserted.

review_context.identity_guard: John son of Zebedee is distinct by default from John of Patmos and from the anonymous/traditional author identity of the Gospel of John.
